description: Get Subscription by ID. The "Get Subscription by ID" API allows to retrieve information for a specific subscription using its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to fetch details for a single subscription based on the provided subscription ID.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

name: crm_getSubscriptionById
